text: na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati . imassa kho bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabboti .pe. aññataro ca pana so bhikkhu arahataṃ ahosīti . [79] sāvatthiyaṃ . atha kho āyasmā ānando sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi . ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ bhagavā etadavoca sace taṃ ānanda evaṃ puccheyyuṃ
